questions.question: What did Jesus' disciples argue about among themselves at the table?

answers.text: Which of them was the greatest
Which of them should lead the prayer
Which of them should go buy supplies

questions.question: Jesus told His disciples they would sit on thrones in His kingdom. What would they be doing there?

answers.text: Judging the twelve tribes of Israel
Teaching the nations of the earth
Counting the people of every land

questions.question: Jesus told Simon that Satan wanted to sift the disciples like wheat. What had Jesus done for Simon?

answers.text: Prayed that his faith would not fail
Sent an angel to stand guard over him
Told him to hide until morning came

questions.question: Peter said he was ready to go with Jesus to prison and death. What did Jesus say Peter would do before the rooster crowed?

answers.text: Deny three times that he knew Jesus
Leave Jerusalem before the sun came up
Go back home to Galilee that night
